data.name: Job_EmailTracking
data.queryText:
SELECT j.jobid,
       j.emailname,
       j.deliveredtime,
       /* SFMC CST (UTC-6) -> PST/PDT */
       Dateadd(hour, 6 + CASE WHEN
                     /* PDT = 2nd Sunday in March to 1st Sunday in November */
                     Dateadd(hour, 6, j.deliveredtime) >= Dateadd( day, ((7
                     - Datepart(
                     weekday, Cast(Year(Dateadd(hour, 6, j.deliveredtime)) AS
                     VARCHAR)
                     + '-03-08' )) % 7),
                     Cast(Year(Dateadd(hour, 6, j.deliveredtime))
                     AS VARCHAR) + '-03-08' ) AND
                     Dateadd(hour, 6, j.deliveredtime) <
                     Dateadd( day, ((7 - Datepart( weekday, Cast(Year(Dateadd(
                     hour, 6,
                     j.deliveredtime)) AS VARCHAR) + '-11-01' )) % 7), Cast(Year
                     (
                     Dateadd(hour, 6, j.deliveredtime)) AS VARCHAR) + '-11-01' )
                     THEN
                     -7 /* PDT */
                     ELSE -8 /* PST */
                     END, j.deliveredtime) AS DeliveredTime_Local,
       j.jobtype,
       j.emailsubject,
       j.category,
       j.suppresstracking,
       j.sendclassificationtype,
       j.sendclassification,
       j.emailsenddefinition,
       j.triggerersenddefinitionobjectid,
       j.triggeredsendcustomerkey
FROM   [_job] j
WHERE  j.suppresstracking = 0

data.name: Aggregate_SMSTracking_Daily
data.queryText:
SELECT
    CAST(ActionDateTime_Local AS DATE) AS AggDate,

    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN Sent = 1 
        THEN CONCAT(SubscriberKey, '_', CAST(MessageID AS CHAR))
    END) AS ContactsSent,

    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN Delivered = 1 
        THEN CONCAT(SubscriberKey, '_', CAST(MessageID AS CHAR))
    END) AS ContactsDelivered,

    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN Undelivered = 1 
        THEN CONCAT(SubscriberKey, '_', CAST(MessageID AS CHAR))
    END) AS ContactsUndelivered, 

    COUNT(CASE WHEN Sent = 1 THEN 1 END) AS SMSSent,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Delivered = 1 THEN 1 END) AS SMSDelivered,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Undelivered = 1 THEN 1 END) AS SMSUndelivered

FROM {{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/80643bde-2974-f111-a5bc-5cba2c7b63f0/data/namePrefix}}[{{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/80643bde-2974-f111-a5bc-5cba2c7b63f0/data/name}}]

GROUP BY 
    CAST(ActionDateTime_Local AS DATE)

data.name: Sent_EmailTracking
data.queryText:
SELECT j.jobid,
       s.eventdate,
       s.subscriberid,
       s.subscriberkey,
       s.triggerersenddefinitionobjectid,
       s.triggeredsendcustomerkey,
       /* SFMC CST (UTC-6) -> PST/PDT */
       Dateadd(hour, 6 + CASE WHEN
                     /* PDT = 2nd Sunday in March to 1st Sunday in November */
                     Dateadd(hour, 6, s.eventdate) >= Dateadd( day, ((7
                     - Datepart(
                     weekday, Cast(Year(Dateadd(hour, 6, s.eventdate)) AS
                     VARCHAR) +
                     '-03-08' )) % 7), Cast(Year(Dateadd(hour, 6, s.eventdate))
                     AS
                     VARCHAR) + '-03-08' ) AND Dateadd(hour, 6, s.eventdate) <
                     Dateadd(
                     day, ((7 - Datepart( weekday,
                     Cast(Year(Dateadd(hour, 6, s.eventdate)) AS VARCHAR) +
                     '-11-01' ))
                     % 7), Cast(Year(Dateadd(hour, 6,
                     s.eventdate)) AS VARCHAR) + '-11-01' ) THEN -7 /* PDT */
                     ELSE -8 /* PST */
                     END, s.eventdate)  AS EventDate_Local
FROM   {{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/7e643bde-2974-f111-a5bc-5cba2c7b63f0/data/namePrefix}}[{{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/7e643bde-2974-f111-a5bc-5cba2c7b63f0/data/name}}] j
       JOIN [_sent] s
         ON j.jobid = s.jobid
WHERE  j.status = 0

data.name: Aggregate_Sent_EmailTracking_Daily
data.queryText:
SELECT
    CAST(s.EventDate_Local AS DATE) AS AggDate,
    COUNT(*) AS TotalSent,
    
    /* Journey Builder sends */
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN ja.JourneyActivityObjectID IS NOT NULL 
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 
    END) AS JBSent,

    /* Triggered Sends (non-JB) */
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN j.TriggeredSendCustomerKey IS NOT NULL AND ja.JourneyActivityObjectID IS NULL 
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 
    END) AS TSSent,
    
    /*  User Initiated Sends */
    SUM(CASE WHEN j.TriggeredSendCustomerKey IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UISent
    
    
FROM
    {{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/7b643bde-2974-f111-a5bc-5cba2c7b63f0/data/namePrefix}}[{{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/7b643bde-2974-f111-a5bc-5cba2c7b63f0/data/name}}] s
INNER JOIN
    {{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/7e643bde-2974-f111-a5bc-5cba2c7b63f0/data/namePrefix}}[{{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/7e643bde-2974-f111-a5bc-5cba2c7b63f0/data/name}}] j
    ON s.JobId = j.JobId
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT JourneyActivityObjectID
    FROM _JourneyActivity
    WHERE JourneyActivityObjectID IS NOT NULL
) ja
ON j.TriggererSendDefinitionObjectID = ja.JourneyActivityObjectID

WHERE
    s.EventDate_Local IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    CAST(s.EventDate_Local AS DATE)

data.name: Calculate_EmailJob_BounceCount
data.queryText:
SELECT
 b.JobId,
 COUNT(*) AS Bounce
FROM {{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/7c643bde-2974-f111-a5bc-5cba2c7b63f0/data/namePrefix}}[{{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/7c643bde-2974-f111-a5bc-5cba2c7b63f0/data/name}}] b
JOIN {{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/7e643bde-2974-f111-a5bc-5cba2c7b63f0/data/namePrefix}}[{{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/7e643bde-2974-f111-a5bc-5cba2c7b63f0/data/name}}] j ON b.JobId = j.JobId
WHERE j.Status = 0
GROUP BY b.JobId

                 c.eventdate)) AS VARCHAR) + '-11-01' ) THEN -7 /* PDT */

data.name: SMSTracking
data.queryText:
SELECT mid,
       mobile,
       messageid,
       keywordid,
       codeid,
       sent,
       undelivered,
       createdatetime,
       actiondatetime,
       istest,
       mobilemessagetrackingid,
       mobilemessagerecurrenceid,
       isvalid,
       invalidationcode,
       sendid,
       sendsplitid,
       sendjobid,
       subscriberkey,
       subscriberid,
       smsjobid,
       NAME,
       jbactivityid,
       jbdefinitionid,
       description,
       delivered,
       /* Convert CST -> UTC -> PST/PDT */
       Dateadd(hour, 6 + CASE WHEN
                     /* PDT = 2nd Sunday in March to 1st Sunday in November */
                     Dateadd(hour, 6, actiondatetime) >= Dateadd( day, ((7
                     - Datepart(
                     weekday, Cast(Year(Dateadd(hour, 6, actiondatetime)) AS
                     VARCHAR) +
                     '-03-08' )) % 7), Cast(Year(Dateadd(hour, 6, actiondatetime
                     )) AS
                     VARCHAR) + '-03-08' ) AND Dateadd(hour, 6, actiondatetime)
                     <
                     Dateadd( day, ((7 - Datepart( weekday, Cast(Year(Dateadd(
                     hour, 6,
                     actiondatetime)) AS VARCHAR) + '-11-01' )) % 7), Cast(Year(
                     Dateadd
                     (hour, 6, actiondatetime)) AS VARCHAR) + '-11-01' ) THEN -7
                     /* PDT */
                     ELSE -8 /* PST */
                     END, actiondatetime) AS ActionDateTime_Local
FROM   _smsmessagetracking
WHERE  istest = 0
       AND actiondatetime >= Dateadd(day, -365, Getdate())

data.name: Aggregate_Unsub_EmailTracking_Daily

        WHEN j.TriggeredSendCustomerKey IS NOT NULL AND ja.JourneyActivityObjectID IS NULL 
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 
    END) AS TSUnsub,
    
    /*  User Initiated Sends */
    SUM(CASE WHEN j.TriggeredSendCustomerKey IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UIUnsub
    
FROM
    {{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/7d643bde-2974-f111-a5bc-5cba2c7b63f0/data/namePrefix}}[{{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/7d643bde-2974-f111-a5bc-5cba2c7b63f0/data/name}}] u

data.name: Aggregate_Bounce_EmailTracking_Daily
data.queryText:
SELECT
    CAST(b.EventDate_Local AS DATE) AS AggDate,
    COUNT(*) AS TotalBounce,
    
    /* Journey Builder sends */
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN ja.JourneyActivityObjectID IS NOT NULL 
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 
    END) AS JBBounce,

    /* Triggered Sends (non-JB) */
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN j.TriggeredSendCustomerKey IS NOT NULL AND ja.JourneyActivityObjectID IS NULL 
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 
    END) AS TSBounce,
    
    /*  User Initiated Sends */
    SUM(CASE WHEN j.TriggeredSendCustomerKey IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UIBounce
    
FROM
    {{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/7c643bde-2974-f111-a5bc-5cba2c7b63f0/data/namePrefix}}[{{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/7c643bde-2974-f111-a5bc-5cba2c7b63f0/data/name}}] b

    ON b.JobId = j.JobId

data.name: Unsub_EmailTracking
data.queryText:
SELECT
    j.JobID,
    u.EventDate,
    u.SubscriberKey,
    u.IsUnique,
    
   /* SFMC CST (UTC-6) -> PST/PDT */
   Dateadd(hour, 6 + CASE WHEN
                 /* PDT = 2nd Sunday in March to 1st Sunday in November */
                 Dateadd(hour, 6, u.eventdate) >= Dateadd( day, ((7
                 - Datepart(
                 weekday, Cast(Year(Dateadd(hour, 6, u.eventdate)) AS
                 VARCHAR) +
                 '-03-08' )) % 7), Cast(Year(Dateadd(hour, 6, u.eventdate))
                 AS
                 VARCHAR) + '-03-08' ) AND Dateadd(hour, 6, u.eventdate) <
                 Dateadd(
                 day, ((7 - Datepart( weekday,
                 Cast(Year(Dateadd(hour, 6, u.eventdate)) AS VARCHAR) +
                 '-11-01' ))
                 % 7), Cast(Year(Dateadd(hour, 6,
                 u.eventdate)) AS VARCHAR) + '-11-01' ) THEN -7 /* PDT */
                 ELSE -8 /* PST */
                 END, u.eventdate)  AS EventDate_Local
    
FROM {{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/7e643bde-2974-f111-a5bc-5cba2c7b63f0/data/namePrefix}}[{{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/7e643bde-2974-f111-a5bc-5cba2c7b63f0/data/name}}] j
JOIN [_Unsubscribe] u
 ON j.JobID = u.JobID
WHERE j.Status = 0
